timed_region: On every rank, the timed interval begins immediately before the iteration loop and ends after all iterations, CUDA stream completion, and the local OpenMP barrier (spmv/spmv.cpp lines 586-596).
start_synchronization: An MPI_Barrier is executed by the OpenMP master, followed by an OpenMP barrier before each thread records its start time (spmv/spmv.cpp lines 575-586). Although not required when complete local durations are reduced with MPI_MAX, this also aligns the beginning of the rank-local phase.
stop_synchronization: Each iteration launches the SpMV kernel on the rank's stream; cudaStreamSynchronize completes all queued kernels before the OpenMP barrier and stop timestamp (spmv/spmv.cpp lines 588-596). Under the recorded target profile, each rank sees one CUDA device, so the device partitioning at lines 488-516 produces one OpenMP worker/device partition per rank.
rank_aggregation: The OpenMP master computes the completed local interval in microseconds and MPI_Allreduce combines all ranks with MPI_MAX using MPI_LONG_LONG (spmv/spmv.cpp lines 598-604).
reported_value: Rank 0 prints the MPI_MAX result converted from microseconds to whole milliseconds as the canonical `Computation time` value (spmv/spmv.cpp lines 605-607). The truncation is ordinary display precision and the LP64 target makes the long conversion compatible.
semantic_equivalence_basis: This is a literal maximum of complete per-rank computation durations. Every rank times all requested SpMV iterations, waits for its asynchronous CUDA work to complete, and participates in MPI_Allreduce with MPI_MAX. Validation-only CPU reference computation occurs before the common GPU execution path (spmv/spmv.cpp lines 432-439), while result copying and MPI_Gatherv occur after the compute-only timer (spmv/spmv.cpp lines 618-645).

evidence.finding: The GPU-owning OpenMP region performs warmup before timing, then executes MPI and OpenMP synchronization before recording the timed start.
The timed work contains every requested SpMV kernel launch, followed by cudaStreamSynchronize and the local OpenMP completion barrier before the stop timestamp.
The complete local elapsed time is reduced across MPI_COMM_WORLD with MPI_MAX, and rank 0 prints that maximum in milliseconds under the canonical label.
The validation-only reference calculation is outside the timer and does not replace or alter the common timed GPU computation.
Device-to-host result copying and final MPI result collection follow the timer, which is permissible for a compute-only SpMV measurement.

notes: The supplied target-profile evidence states that both validation and full benchmarking launch exactly four MPI ranks through local_gpu_rank_wrapper.rb, whose lines 3-10 restrict each rank to one CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES entry. Consequently cudaGetDeviceCount at spmv/spmv.cpp lines 488-489 sees one device per rank, and the partition logic at lines 504-516 selects one device partition; counterexamples requiring multiple visible devices per rank do not apply to this profile.
